name: com.agentscouthq/directory
title: AgentScout MCP server
description: Read-only search over 5,716+ AI agent tools and 3,177 MCP servers listed on AgentScout (com.agentscouthq/directory at https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp). 100% free, public, no authentication or x402 wallet required.
dataLocalityFilter: Optional runs_locally filter on search_tools and best_for_task: offline (runs fully on your own machine), self_hosted_or_offline (also tools you can deploy on your own server) or any. Each result has a data_locality label inferred from its listing; verify with the vendor before relying on it for compliance.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the AgentScout directory of AI agent tools and MCP servers by keyword, with optional category, pricing, open-source and data-locality (runs_locally) filters. Each result has data_locality (offline, self_hosted, cloud or unknown) with a plain note. Returns up to 25 matches with pricing as the maker states it and the AgentScout listing URL.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get the full AgentScout listing for one tool by its slug (from search_tools results), including key features, platforms, GitHub repo and stars, and data_locality with the evidence phrase.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List every AgentScout category with its tool count and page URL.

tools.name: best_for_task
tools.description: Suggest AgentScout tools for a task described in plain words (e.g. 'scrape websites with an agent'), ranked by relevance with listed GitHub stars as a tiebreak. Optional pricing, open-source and runs_locally filters; use runs_locally when data must stay on the user's machine or servers (e.g. 'no-code automation that runs locally').

tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: List AgentScout's 4 maker listing packages ($0, $15 Fast-Track with a same-day Bing and IndexNow ping, $49 category pin, $99/wk sponsor), and the Made by AgentScout pre-trained bot lineup. The $99 weekly sponsorship includes submissions to about 25 other AI directories, with a report of the links.
